cost_stress.rule: ledger-linear sensitivity on the frozen event cohort: the committed fill path (bar, side, qty, price, fee) is held fixed and the stressed daily equity is base_equity - (multiplier - 1) * cumulative one-way cost per fill, where one-way cost = fee + qty * price * slippage_rate; all arms use the same assumptions

harness_control.check: the 1x level is compared against the committed equity path before writing

not_rerun.engine_cost_rebinding: NOT_RERUN: changing the engine fee/slippage inputs would require a new native-event run; RF-05 deliberately does not rerun the engine for a stress panel or a CI

no interval is an untouched holdout; the protocol is registered in RF-05 and must not be run in this study
RF-04 executed the bounded 8 trials/cutoff design; the wider budget stays frozen for a later prospective run
the event account runs with use_funding=False under the registered contract
M4_*_NEIGH arms were never run; SELECTOR and INTERACTION have no data
